title: The 2-minute morning mobility reset
idea: Most people wake up stiff and immediately sit down. Show a 4-move, 2-minute mobility flow anyone can do next to their bed, framed as the cheapest energy hack there is.
angle: Contrarian: you don't need a 45-minute workout, you need 2 minutes before coffee.
audience_pain: Feeling stiff, low energy in the morning, no time.
key_points: Cat-cow x 5 wakes up the spine
Thread the needle for the upper back
10 bodyweight squats to fire up the legs
cta: Save this and do it tomorrow morning.
